title: Implementar runner CI browser para verificar el mapa José V12
mission: Implement a deterministic GitHub Actions/Playwright runner for the existing José Study V12 map LAB candidate so generic repository workers can launch representative JavaScript-browser evidence without pretending their local runtime has browser capability. The runner must preserve the pinned V11 SHA gate, enter one topic-local map, capture rail/level/round evidence, exercise the V12/V11 A/B toggle, and persist bounded artifacts without promoting product authority.
definition_of_done: Add a deterministic Playwright test that opens the existing V12 LAB candidate in a representative JavaScript browser.
Assert and record the pinned V11 SHA-256 gate before treating the candidate as usable.
Enter at least one topic-local map and record rail, level and round counts.
Exercise the V12/V11 A/B toggle and prove V11 remains reachable/intact.
Wire the test into a bounded GitHub Actions workflow or compatible existing browser-verification workflow and persist machine-readable evidence plus screenshots.
Do not change Current, Human Accepted, Served or Student World publication authority; CI evidence remains technical verification only.
